title: Avience
description: Avience is a 13 year old vanilla Minecraft survival multiplayer. The server has 1K+ whitelisted players, every farm in the game, and a lively in-game diamond based economy. Founded by YouTuber JaysTechVault in 2013. Come apply to join today!
